Ecosistema marino propuesto
A proposed marine ecosystem
Nueve familias, una arquitectura marina compartida: definida por partes, pendiente de verificación.
Nine families, one shared marine architecture: defined in parts, still to be verified.
MAREA se propone como un ecosistema de instrumentación marina que reúne navegación, supervisión y datos de a bordo en un mismo lenguaje de producto.
MAREA is proposed as a marine instrumentation ecosystem that brings navigation, supervision and onboard data into one product language.
Borrador interno. No es una oferta comercial ni una página pública autorizada.
Internal draft. It is not a commercial offer and not an authorised public page.
Las nueve familias están definidas, pero no hay precio aprobado ni venta autorizada.
The nine families are defined, but no price is approved and no sale is authorised.
Nueve familias definidas: NAV, HUB, AIS, PILOT, SENSE, WATCH, DISPLAY, WEATHER y FLEET.
Nine defined families: NAV, HUB, AIS, PILOT, SENSE, WATCH, DISPLAY, WEATHER and FLEET.
Seis conceptos de solución definidos internamente: sin precio, sin stock y sin entrega.
Six internally defined solution concepts: no price, no stock and no delivery.
Integración no verificada: no hay pruebas de compatibilidad registradas.
Unverified integration: no compatibility tests are recorded.
Ecosistema
Ecosystem
Cinco capas para leer, supervisar y conectar el barco
Five layers to read, supervise and connect the vessel
La propuesta organiza el ecosistema en capas: hardware, software a bordo, monitorización y sensores, integración y conectividad, y servicios digitales.
The proposal organises the ecosystem in layers: hardware, onboard software, monitoring and sensors, integration and connectivity, and digital services.
Hardware
Hardware
Las familias HUB, AIS, PILOT, SENSE, WATCH y DISPLAY cubren el hardware previsto del ecosistema.
The HUB, AIS, PILOT, SENSE, WATCH and DISPLAY families cover the planned hardware of the ecosystem.
Software a bordo
Onboard software
NAV y WEATHER son las familias de software definidas; el software a bordo se describe como parte de la arquitectura.
NAV and WEATHER are the defined software families; onboard software is described as part of the architecture.
Monitorización y sensores
Monitoring and sensors
SENSE define módulos de viento, energía, sentinas, tanques y ambiente; WATCH se define como supervisión con alertas.
SENSE defines wind, power, bilge, tank and environmental modules; WATCH is defined as supervision with alerts.
Integración y conectividad
Integration and connectivity
La integración se propone sobre interfaces documentadas; no hay compatibilidad probada ni matriz de integración publicada.
Integration is proposed over documented interfaces; no compatibility is tested and no integration matrix is published.
Servicios digitales
Digital services
FLEET se define como solución contratada de gestión de flota; no incluye hardware por defecto ni tiene SLA establecido.
FLEET is defined as a contracted fleet-management solution; it includes no default hardware and has no established SLA.
Las capas son una propuesta de arquitectura interna: no acreditan interoperabilidad, conformidad ni disponibilidad comercial.
The layers are an internal architecture proposal: they attest no interoperability, no conformity and no commercial availability.
Familias
Families
Nueve familias, cada una con su alcance declarado
Nine families, each with a declared scope
Cada familia se registra con su estado de ciclo de vida, sus dimensiones de disponibilidad y su disponibilidad comercial.
Each family is recorded with its lifecycle state, its availability dimensions and its commercial availability.
NAV es la familia de software de navegación: planificación de rutas, vista de carta, cuaderno de bitácora digital y visualización de datos de instrumentos, en dos ediciones definidas.
NAV is the navigation software family: route planning, chart view, digital logbook and instrument data display, in two defined editions.
Las cartas náuticas no están licenciadas ni se representan como incluidas.
Nautical charts are not licensed and are not represented as included.
NAV no está disponible para compra: no hay precio aprobado ni suscripción autorizada.
NAV is not available for purchase: no price is approved and no subscription is authorised.
HUB se define como la pasarela de datos y conectividad a bordo, en dos ediciones internas.
HUB is defined as the onboard data gateway and connectivity appliance, in two internal editions.
No hay hardware seleccionado ni evidencia de conformidad para HUB.
No hardware is selected and no conformity evidence exists for HUB.
HUB no se vende: no hay stock, precio aprobado ni plazo de entrega.
HUB is not sold: there is no stock, no approved price and no delivery lead time.
AIS se define como receptor de solo escucha para identificar tráfico cercano.
AIS is defined as a receive-only receiver for identifying nearby traffic.
La recepción AIS no transmite, no evita colisiones y no sustituye la vigilancia: no todos los buques emiten AIS.
AIS reception does not transmit, does not prevent collisions and does not replace watchkeeping: not every vessel transmits AIS.
AIS no está disponible para pedido: no hay precio aprobado ni existencias.
AIS is not available to order: no price is approved and no stock exists.
PILOT se define como gobierno asistido y supervisado: mantiene un rumbo o sigue una ruta autorizada por el patrón, con toma de control manual siempre disponible.
PILOT is defined as assisted, supervised steering: it holds a heading or follows a route authorised by the skipper, with manual takeover always available.
El gate de seguridad de PILOT está bloqueado: no hay gobierno autónomo, ni control remoto sin supervisión, ni prueba de mar registrada.
PILOT safety gate is blocked: there is no autonomous steering, no unattended remote control and no recorded sea trial.
PILOT no es comprable en ningún estado: no se ofrece precio ni disponibilidad.
PILOT is not purchasable in any state: no price and no availability are offered.
SENSE reúne módulos de viento, energía, sentinas, tanques y ambiente; SENSE-ESSENTIALS representa energía y sentinas.
SENSE brings together wind, power, bilge, tank and environmental modules; SENSE-ESSENTIALS represents power and bilge.
SENSE-ESSENTIALS representa POWER y BILGE; los módulos no se cuentan dos veces en la composición del paquete.
SENSE-ESSENTIALS represents POWER and BILGE; the modules are not counted twice in the bundle composition.
SENSE no está a la venta: no hay precio aprobado, stock ni disponibilidad.
SENSE is not for sale: no approved price, stock or availability exists.
WATCH se define como supervisión del barco con alertas locales y avisos al propietario cuando la conectividad lo permite.
WATCH is defined as vessel supervision with local alerts and owner notifications when connectivity permits.
Las alertas pueden retrasarse o perderse; no hay monitorización remota continua garantizada ni servicio de emergencia.
Alerts may be delayed or lost; there is no guaranteed continuous remote monitoring and no emergency service.
WATCH no está disponible para compra: no hay SLA establecido ni precio aprobado.
WATCH is not available for purchase: no SLA is established and no price is approved.
DISPLAY se define como pantalla multifunción de puesto de mando, en dos ediciones internas, una de ellas condicional.
DISPLAY is defined as a helm multifunction display, in two internal editions, one of them conditional.
No hay unidad fabricada ni tamaño de pantalla congelado; no se publican dimensiones finales.
No manufactured unit exists and the screen size is not frozen; no final dimensions are published.
DISPLAY no se vende: no hay precio aprobado ni disponibilidad.
DISPLAY is not sold: no price is approved and no availability exists.
WEATHER se define como servicio de previsión marina con fuente y hora por dato, dentro de un área y horizonte declarados.
WEATHER is defined as a marine forecast service with source and timestamp per data point, within a declared area and horizon.
Los datos meteorológicos no están licenciados ni se representan como incluidos; las previsiones son probabilísticas.
Weather data is not licensed and is not represented as included; forecasts are probabilistic.
WEATHER no está a la venta: no hay precio ni suscripción aprobada.
WEATHER is not for sale: no price and no subscription are approved.
FLEET se define como solución de gestión de flota para armadores y operadores pequeños, con telemetría de solo lectura.
FLEET is defined as a fleet-management solution for owners and small operators, with read-only telemetry.
FLEET no incluye hardware por defecto, no tiene SLA establecido y no dispone de disponibilidad medida.
FLEET includes no default hardware, has no established SLA and has no measured availability.
FLEET es una solución contratada: no se ofrece como autoservicio ni con precio público.
FLEET is a contracted solution: it is not offered as self-service and has no public price.
Las nueve fichas declaran su restricción material y comercial; no se presentan como productos disponibles.
All nine entries state their material and commercial restriction; they are not presented as available products.

Paquetes
Bundles

Six internally defined solution concepts
START, CRUISE, SAIL, PROTECT, COMPLETE y FLEET se definen como composiciones internas de ediciones.
START, CRUISE, SAIL, PROTECT, COMPLETE and FLEET are defined as internal compositions of editions.
START combina HUB Standard y NAV Pro, con HUB Pro y WEATHER Standard como opciones internas.
START combines HUB Standard and NAV Pro, with HUB Pro and WEATHER Standard as internal options.
START es un concepto interno de solución: no tiene precio, stock ni plazo de entrega.
START is an internal solution concept: it has no price, no stock and no delivery lead time.

Installation, cabling and commissioning are not included: they require installer assistance.
CRUISE combina NAV Essential, HUB Standard, AIS Receiver y la edición DISPLAY 7, con ampliaciones opcionales.
CRUISE combines NAV Essential, HUB Standard, AIS Receiver and the DISPLAY 7 edition, with optional extensions.
CRUISE no incluye precio aprobado, stock ni fecha de entrega: es un concepto interno de solución.
CRUISE includes no approved price, no stock and no delivery date: it is an internal solution concept.
La instalación profesional es obligatoria; el cableado y la puesta en marcha no se incluyen.
Professional installation is mandatory; cabling and commissioning are not included.
SAIL combina NAV Pro y HUB Standard con PILOT Coastal, sujeto a cotización interna.
SAIL combines NAV Pro and HUB Standard with PILOT Coastal, subject to an internal quotation.
PILOT en SAIL es asistido y supervisado: no permite gobierno autónomo ni control remoto sin supervisión, y el gate de seguridad sigue bloqueado.
PILOT in SAIL is assisted and supervised: it allows no autonomous steering and no unattended remote control, and the safety gate remains blocked.
SAIL no tiene precio, stock ni entrega definidos: no es una oferta comercial.
SAIL has no price, no stock and no delivery defined: it is not a commercial offer.
PROTECT combina WATCH Core con SENSE Essentials, que representa energía y sentinas.
PROTECT combines WATCH Core with SENSE Essentials, which represents power and bilge.
SENSE Essentials representa POWER y BILGE; los módulos no se cuentan dos veces en la composición.
SENSE Essentials represents POWER and BILGE; the modules are not counted twice in the composition.
PROTECT no incluye alertas garantizadas ni monitorización remota continua; no hay precio ni stock.
PROTECT includes no guaranteed alerts and no continuous remote monitoring; there is no price and no stock.
COMPLETE reúne NAV Pro, HUB Pro, DISPLAY 7, WATCH Core, los módulos SENSE definidos y PILOT Coastal.
COMPLETE brings together NAV Pro, HUB Pro, DISPLAY 7, WATCH Core, the defined SENSE modules and PILOT Coastal.
COMPLETE no está disponible para pedido: no tiene precio, stock ni entrega, y PILOT mantiene el gate de seguridad bloqueado.
COMPLETE is not available to order: it has no price, no stock and no delivery, and PILOT keeps its safety gate blocked.
Las ediciones condicionales no son seleccionables: PILOT Pro y DISPLAY Large Conditional no forman parte del paquete.
Conditional editions are not selectable: PILOT Pro and DISPLAY Large Conditional are not part of the bundle.
FLEET se define como solución contratada de gestión de flota para flotas profesionales.
FLEET is defined as a contracted fleet-management solution for professional fleets.
FLEET es una solución contratada: no incluye hardware por defecto y no tiene SLA establecido.
FLEET is a contracted solution: it includes no default hardware and has no established SLA.

FLEET has no public price and no availability: it is not offered as self-service.
